analysis.summary: Function `average` has a bug in calculating the arithmetic mean.

findings.title: Incorrect Calculation of Total
findings.explanation: The loop only adds up to the second-to-last element, missing the last element in the list. This results in an incorrect total for the mean calculation.
findings.why_incorrect: The loop should iterate up to the last element of the list, not the second-to-last.
findings.suggested_fix: Change the loop condition to `range(len(nums))` to include the last element.

findings.title: Incorrect Logic
findings.explanation: The function checks if `day` is both "Saturday" and "Sunday", which is incorrect. It should check if `day` is either "Saturday" or "Sunday".
findings.why_incorrect: The logical operator `and` requires both conditions to be true, but in this case, it should be `or` to check for either condition being true.

analysis.corrected_code:
def is_weekend(day):
    return day == "Saturday" or day == "Sunday"
